howto.name: Upload a PDF
howto.text: Drop a PDF up to 500 MB. Works best on text-heavy PDFs with a clear structure.

howto.name: PrivaTools extracts text and reflows it
howto.text: Headings, paragraphs, lists, and embedded images are identified and converted into EPUB chapter structure.

howto.name: Download the EPUB
howto.text: Open in any e-reader (Kindle, Apple Books, calibre) for a reflowable reading experience.

faq.q: How accurate is the EPUB compared to the PDF?
faq.a: Text and basic structure transfer well. Complex multi-column layouts, footnotes, and figure captions may need cleanup in calibre.
Yes — embedded images are included as EPUB resources at original resolution.

faq.q: Will the table of contents work?
faq.a: If the PDF has bookmarks, they become the EPUB's TOC. Without bookmarks, the TOC is built from detected headings.
